scope: Source-only review against frozen execution, admission, recipe, observer and producer contracts; no collector invocation, live artifact inventory, prediction values or evaluator labels/masks.
findings: Execution receipt supplies the exact recipe path/hash and unit/invocation fields consumed by the collector.
Admission, twelve-cell recipe, candidate output filenames/sidecar fields, little-endian float32 C-order headers and observer identity fields agree.
Collector gates on the exact invocation becoming inactive or failed and never hashes or reads prediction payload values.
non_blocking_limits: Collector does not separately compare admission.recipe.sha256 with execution.recipe.sha256; reviewer checked that current frozen hashes agree.
Collector does not validate every sidecar fold/seed/lag/arm/group against each recipe cell. Exact coverage and prediction digests remain the independent all-fourteen-endpoint grader responsibility.
